mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'list' searches the register (optionally filtered) and returns matching tenders. 'detail' fetches full information for specific tender URLs (e.g. the 'detailUrl' field from a previous 'list' run).

entidad.title: Institution name contains (list mode)
entidad.description: Optional. Filters to tenders from one government institution -- a case-insensitive substring match against the register's institution list (e.g. "Salud" matches the Ministry of Health). Leave empty to search all institutions.

etapa.title: Stage (list mode)
etapa.description: Filter by process stage. Use 'Receiving offers' or 'Under evaluation' for currently-open tenders, or 'Awarded' for completed contract awards.

expediente.title: Exact tender/record number (list mode)
expediente.description: Optional. Look up one specific tender by its exact 'Expediente' record number.

fechaInicio.title: Start date from (list mode)
fechaInicio.description: Optional. Format dd/mm/yyyy. Filters to tenders whose start date falls on/after this date.

fechaFin.title: Start date to (list mode)
fechaFin.description: Optional. Format dd/mm/yyyy. Filters to tenders whose start date falls on/before this date.

maxResults.title: Max results (list mode)
maxResults.description: Maximum number of tenders to return for a 'list' search. The register paginates 30 rows per page; this actor pages through until it reaches this many results.

fetchDetail.title: Also fetch full detail per tender (list mode)
fetchDetail.description: When true, also fetches each tender's detail page (contact, line items, documents, bidders, award) and merges it into the same record. Slower -- one extra request per tender.

url.title: Tender detail URL (detail mode)
url.description: A single ProcesoHistorico.aspx detail URL to fetch (e.g. the 'detailUrl' field from a 'list' mode run).

urls.title: Tender detail URLs (detail mode)
urls.description: Multiple detail URLs to fetch in one run. Combined with 'url' if both are set.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many detail pages to fetch in parallel (used by 'detail' mode, and by 'list' mode when 'fetchDetail' is on). Keep this low -- the register's server is slow and can take 20-40s per page.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
